headline: Bases Swap Hands Across Seven Fronts as Fighting Intensifies
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the strategic map has grown still more volatile. Weathered Expanse remains the bloodiest sector, adding another thirteen thousand Colonial and fifteen thousand Warden casualties while recording thirty‑two ownership flips in the past day, the most of any region. Fishermans Row follows closely with thirty‑nine flips centred on Eidolo, Black Well and Arcadia. Stlican Shelf continues to churn, posting twenty‑five flips across The Old Mourn, Vulpine Watch, The Pale House and Thornhold. Fresh surges appear in Mooring County and Linn Mercy, each logging six flips in the last two hours and new events recorded at the moment of this dispatch; Stonecradle also shows a renewed pulse with three flips in the same window. Marban Hollow, Farranac Coast and Godcrofts retain lower‑level turnover. The remainder of the theatre is largely static, showing only incremental casualties. Enlistment rates are accelerating in the most contested zones, indicating fresh manpower feeding the ongoing exchanges.
